movieinfo.synopsis:
A Haunting and Thrilling Story with Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson as Leads!

Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is on the brink of financial ruin when she accepts the job offer of a lifetime: she's been hired to complete the remaining books in a successful series that bestselling thriller author Verity Crawford is unable to finish after a mysterious accident. Upon arrival at the lavish Crawford estate, Ashleigh slowly learns that things are not exactly as they seem.
movieinfo.staticContent:
Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive, psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity.
 
After Lowen uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband, Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), and finds it hard to separate fiction from reality, manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.

Starting Again With a New Job

Young CEO, Sun-woo(played by Han So Hee), the 10 billion revenue legend in just three years, who made her brand WOO22(Woo-two-two) a dark horse in fashion, has been working flat-out for the success, meets her company’s new senior intern, Ki-ho(played by Choi Min Shik).

Even though he’s a man with 37 years of experience, Ki-ho struggles at WOO22, adjusting himself to the digital workplace and freewheeling office culture. But thanks to Ki-ho’s diligence and down-to-earth personality, Sun-woo gradually opens up to him, and the two, completely different in every possible way, share POVs and experiences that they lack in each other, which eventually brings an unexpected warmth to their hectic everyday lives…

movieinfo.synopsis:
沈腾撕掉喜剧标签！被观众称为演技巅峰 🔥

东北大厨徐福（沈腾 饰）为养家还债，扛着炒锅跑去中东一家中餐馆做厨师。他亮出龙抬头、拔丝地瓜、宫保鸡丁等各色中华美食，和前台经理马俊生（蒋奇明 饰）一个掌勺一个揽客，愣是把无人问津的龙餐馆经营得风生水起！然而战争突然爆发，当地局势急转直下。乱世之中，各方势力轮番登场，徐福的命运将会何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
 
Xu Fu (Shen Teng), a chef from Northeast China, heads to the Middle East to work at a Chinese restaurant. Carrying his wok, he hopes to support his family and pay off his debts. He serves up classic Chinese dishes: the Dragon‐Raising‐Its‐Head feast, candied sweet potatoes and Kung Pao chicken. He partners with restaurant manager Ma Junsheng (Jiang Qiming): Xu Fu handles the cooking, while Ma Junsheng takes care of guests. Together, they turn the little‐known Dragon Restaurant into a thriving spot.
 
War soon breaks out, and local conditions quickly turn dangerous. Different armed groups clash across the region. What will happen to Xu Fu? Can Dragon Restaurant survive amid the chaos of war?

Alternate Synopsis

Chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef at a Chinese restaurant to support his family and pay off debts. There, he meets Ma Jun Sheng, the restaurant's manager. They attract customers from all over with authentic Chinese cuisine, and the restaurant quickly gains fame. However, with the outbreak of war, the situation deteriorates rapidly, and no one can escape unscathed, including Xu Fu and Ma Jun Sheng.

 

徐福（沈腾 饰）为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生（蒋奇明 饰）。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
